title: Red-cell size–dispersion coupling does not improve temporal HbA1c prediction beyond flexible standard indices
abstract: In 2,086 eligible NHANES 2011–2012 adults, adding MCV×RDW/100 to a model trained on 2,392 NHANES 2009–2010 adults did not improve HbA1c prediction beyond flexible fasting glucose and separate CBC indices: weighted RMSE 0.349619 versus 0.349817 percentage points; improvement -0.000199, paired PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.005013, 0.001154].
